name: codemode
description: Run read-only workspace JS. Await tools.read({path}) or tools.read({next}), tools.search({pattern}), tools.ls({path}); with network enabled also await tools.web.fetch({url}) and tools.web.search({query}). Return your answer; bare expressions return null.

timeoutSeconds.description: Guest deadline; default 10s. Host I/O may finish later.
